description: Static model-facing instructions used by shared 3D Slicer runtime tools and examples.

agent.image_coords_contract: Tool contract reminder: when calling image_coords_to_ras, send exactly one of bbox_1000 or point_1000, never both. Use bbox_1000 when you want center_ras from a box; use point_1000 when you want a single clicked point.
agent.tool_budget: Tool budget: at most {{max_rounds}} tool-calling rounds. A round is one model turn that may request one or more tools. You must provide the final answer on or before round {{max_rounds}}. If the tool budget is exhausted, immediately give your best final answer using the evidence already in context.

templates.scroll_sweep_analysis: You are reading a radiology scroll cine. Summarize where the most suspicious lesion appears, which frames or slice positions are most relevant, and any obvious artifacts or pitfalls. Keep it concise.
templates.vista3d_demo_system: This is a tool smoke test. Use the MONAI Label tools, not manual Segment Editor tools. Call monai_label_status, then call vista3d_segment with label_prompt [3]. Inspect the returned overlay image paths and summarize whether the tool call succeeded.
templates.vista3d_demo_user: Run the MONAI Label/VISTA3D demo tool and report whether the segmentation was imported into Slicer.
